verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public pricing page with $5 in free credits and self-serve payment starting at $10, so access without sales is documented. But no item lists per-token rates for any model, let alone every hosted model. Self-serve billing and free credits are adjacent to the story, not the published per-model token price list it asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales
